episodes_selected.episode_title: 18 Month Sleep Regression: Boundary Testing & How to Handle It

placement.placement_rationale: This episode directly addresses the 18-month sleep regression and bedtime battles, which is the core topic of Module 4. It explains boundary testing behavior and provides comprehensive strategies that complement the TikTok videos already in this lesson.

key_segments.segment_text: The 18 month sleep regression is more of a limit testing boundary pushing behavior. So what you'll notice is that you'll be able to put your child down for bedtime. It typically happens at bedtime. And so you'll put little Johnny down at bedtime and they will, and he will be going down beautifully. But then one day you'll start to notice that there's a bit of a difference now...
key_segments.relevance: Perfect explanation of what the 18-month regression actually is - boundary testing, not sleep training failure

key_segments.segment_text: And you need to find a way to come up with a very clear response in order to create a really calm, predictable pattern, again, for your toddler to predict and expect. So we need to go back to basics and sort of go in with a really clear bedtime routine where you are highlighting everything is the last thing going on...
key_segments.relevance: Clear strategy for setting boundaries at bedtime - directly applicable to lesson content

episodes_selected.description: Your toddler's been a great sleeper for months. Then one night they start demanding more books, more cuddles, more everything. You're trapped in the room for two hours wondering what happened to your independent sleeper. This is the 18 month sleep regression, and it's less about sleep and more about boundaries.

placement.placement_rationale: This episode covers nap transitions and early wakes, which are key topics in Module 3. It provides additional depth on the 2-to-1 transition process and troubleshooting strategies that complement the TikTok video content on transitional schedules.

key_segments.segment_text: What would be your recommended wake windows for 20 months? So one nap... And then a four hour wake window until bed... Yep, we love a four hour wake window to bed... But neurologically, our little ones are tapping out... You want to get them in well rested rather than getting to the silly zone, overtired.

Plus the definitive answer on when to drop to one nap and why your 7-month-old probably still needs three naps even if everyone says otherwise.

episodes_selected.description: Got a baby waking at 5AM? Wondering if your nap schedule needs tweaking? This week Sally and Bec answer your real questions about early rising, nap timing, and breaking the feed-to-sleep cycle. They go deep on why 5AM is an overnight waking (not morning), how to future-proof your sleep wins, and the step-by-step approach.
